answer: Charge newcomers a congestion-priced entry bond: the fee rises steeply with how many behaviourally similar identities joined recently, like a river swelling after rain, while a lone honest agent pays almost nothing. The bond is held, not spent, and refunded only after months of verified useful service. A sybil farmer spawning thousands of clones faces an ocean of escalating costs, each extra identity dearer than the last, while a single quartz-clear honest newcomer passes cheaply. Clones cannot share or transfer one bond, and proven fraud forfeits it, making mass forgery self-defeating.
